title: Happy Birthday Wishes
author: Sam
description: BirthdayWishes.co.za offers ready-to-use words for many birthday moments. The site has caring messages, light jokes, religious blessings, and polite greetings for work contacts. Content is grouped by age and relationship, so readers can quickly find a suitable idea. It helps people prepare messages for cards, private chats, and posts on social media.

title: Dakdekker Hardenberg
author: Dakdekker Hardenberg
description: Welkom bij de podcast van Dakdekker Hardenberg, dé plek voor praktische informatie, slimme tips en deskundige inzichten over alles wat met daken te maken heeft. Als lokale specialist in dakwerk helpen we huiseigenaren en ondernemers in Hardenberg en omgeving om hun dak veilig, sterk en duurzaam te houden.In onze afleveringen bespreken we onderwerpen zoals dakreparatie, dakonderhoud, daklekkages, dakrenovatie, dakpannen, dakgoten, EPDM, bitumen en schoorsteenreparaties. We leggen uit waar u op moet letten bij schade, wanneer onderhoud verstandig is en welke oplossingen passen bij verschillende soorten daken. Ook delen we handige aandachtspunten voor het plannen van werkzaamheden en het maken van weloverwogen keuzes.Dakdekker Hardenberg staat voor duidelijkheid, vakmanschap en dakwerk zonder zorgen, van de eerste inspectie tot de uiteindelijke oplevering. Met onze podcast willen we ingewikkelde dakvragen begrijpelijk maken en u helpen problemen vroegtijdig te herkennen.Luister mee voor bruikbare adviezen en betrouwbare informatie van een lokale roofing company die uw dak centraal stelt. Meer weten of een gratis, vrijblijvende offerte aanvragen? Heeft u een dakvraag? Ontdek onze diensten en vraag eenvoudig een offerte aan. Bezoek onze website: https://dakdekkerhardenberg.net.

title: Quickie with a Vibe
author: SWELL Collective
description:
Join sex therapists Dr. Danielle Armour and Dr. Ashley Sweet as they combine data-driven sex education with Millennial wit to destigmatize pleasure, untangle relationship dynamics, and answer the sex questions you’re usually too afraid to Google. Consider this your weekly dose of unapologetic, science-backed pleasure ed—served quick, with a side of good vibes.
Find them on IG @quickiewithavibe

title: Emerging Evidence Podcast
author: Leah
description:
Emerging Evidence is the podcast about Australian health and mental health research as it happens. Registered nurse

Leah Veenhuizen talks with the researchers behind current studies and trials, in plain language, including the ones offering free programs to everyday people right now.

title: Before It Begins
author: Impala & Peacock
description: Five minutes with a cup of tea, every weekday morning. Pour the water, watch the colour arrive, and hear one true thing about what's in the cup — why lemon myrtle carries more lemon than a lemon does, why hibiscus isn't a flower, why no ginger plant has ever been found growing wild. Then one thought worth carrying into the day. A new blend each week, Monday to Friday. Made by Impala & Peacock Artisan Teas, blended by hand in Melbourne. Best taken with something steeping.

title: Long way down
author: Ranav Pillay
description: About how William goes through grief and trauma

title: The Intent Podcast: Leveraging Lessons from the TV Industry to Help Organisations Create Intentional Idea and Opportunity Flows
author: Intent
description:
Welcome to the Intent podcast, where industry experts Claire Tavernier and Richard Vargas explore the world of TV production. Join us as we delve into the intricate process of selecting, developing, and managing new TV show ideas. Our guests, including top producers, writers, and executives, share their valuable insights to help you make better business decisions.As a $500bn/yr global industry, television has become a master of creativity at scale. With tens of thousands of new shows launching every year and existing ones constantly evolving, the TV industry has honed its ability to manage a constant pipeline of fresh ideas.Whether you're in the TV industry or another business sector, you'll gain a deeper understanding of how to manage a constant pipeline of new ideas and navigate the complexities of the ideation process.If you’re interested in learning how we at Intent can help you select the right business opportunities, say ‘no’ to the wrong ones, and scale your growth, head over to our website at www.weareintent.com. 

[Music cues and sound effects credits: SergeQuadrado and Borys Kozielski from Pixabay]

title: Emotional Alchemy
author: Baylee Summer
description:
This is the Emotional Alchemy podcast, where high-sensitives, entrepreneurs, and those in the depths of transition receive the codes to emotional alchemy; a process of somatically feeling your emotions to free up your energy, heal old wounds, cultivate a deep connection with yourself…

And, in it’s most uniquely potent form, emotional alchemy has the power to transmute deep suffering into euphoric bliss.

In this podcast, we’ll explore how to live in a way that feels beautiful—in both ease and pain.

I’m your host, Baylee Summer. A business & emotional alchemy coach, and lifelong horsewoman with an obsession for connecting: to myself, my body, the earth, and the beautiful souls around me—human and animal alike.

Thank you for being here. Let’s dive deep.

title: It’s An Us Thing
author: Brett and Christina Varvel
description: Life was never meant to be lived separately—and neither was following Jesus. It’s An Us Thing with Brett & Christina Varvel is an honest, faith-filled conversation about marriage, parenting, calling, suffering, hope, laughter, and everyday life. Through storytelling, vulnerability, and biblical truth, Brett and Christina bring real-life stories back to Jesus and invite you to pursue Him together—wherever life takes you. Come listen in as they bring the Gospel into real life—and discover what happens when “me” becomes “us,” and “us” keeps pointing back to Him.

title: Lux Radio Theater | Old Time Radio
author: Old Time Retro Radio
description:
https://www.oldtimeretroradio.com Lux Radio Theater brings the golden age of Hollywood to classic radio, presenting lavish, full-length adaptations of major motion pictures performed by the original stars who made them famous. These restored broadcasts deliver sweeping drama, romance, adventure, comedy, and unforgettable performances from some of the greatest actors in cinema history. With rich soundscapes, grand storytelling, and timeless Hollywood charm, Lux Radio Theater remains one of the most celebrated programs of classic American broadcasting. 🎧 Fully restored and professionally remastered with enhanced audio.
Source: OTRR.org – Certified Public Domain Collection.
Restoration and curation by Old Time Retro Radio. 🎧 Listen to Lux Radio Theater and all our restored shows on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.
📻 Search Old Time Retro Radio on your favorite podcast app to explore the complete collection. #OldTimeRadio #LuxRadioTheater #GoldenAgeBroadcast #ClassicHollywood #VintageDrama

title: The Possibilist Podcast (PSSBLST)
author: Justin Perkins
description: Stories of adventure and lessons in wisdom from Justin Perkins and his network of founders, artists, leaders, athletes, and adventurers and Possibilists. This podcast explores the wonder and grit required to be a successful modern human, bringing big ideas into the world, with an emphasis on the Founder to CEO journey that is the ultimate modern rite of passage for creative humans. Host Justin Perkins is a serial entrepreneur, author, and founder coach, a former competitive athlete, musician and world adventurer. This podcast includes a mix of reflective rite-of-passage experiences, stories, and interviews with exceptional possibilists, intimate coaching sessions that led to breakthroughs, and a deep exploration of possibilism - a skill that anyone can develop.  Possibilism is an upgrade to optimism - it is "someone who neither hopes without reason nor fears without reason, but sees progress because they are willing to look honestly at reality." And you will join the Possible List - a network of Possibilists - in creating your own list of what's possible.

title: Mr. Content Talkshow
author: Akash Jaiswal
description: This podcast will cover topics related to branding , social.media , storytelling , copywriting , marketing , persuasion and much more related to human behavior.

title: The Educator's Why
author: Doug Yarbrough and Tori Sinco
description:
Behind every educator is a story—a journey filled with challenges, victories, lessons learned, and an unwavering commitment to students. This podcast goes beyond the headlines and the classroom to uncover the heart of education: the people who dedicate their lives to making a difference.
In each episode, we'll sit down with teachers, principals, superintendents, and education leaders to explore their personal journeys, the experiences that shaped them, and the purpose that fuels their work every day. Along the way, we'll discuss leadership, innovation, policy, technology, and the future of ed

title: Holy-ish The perfect place for people who aren’t
author: lisavoorhies
description:
Welcome to Holyish—the podcast for people who love Jesus and want to do real life. No fake it til ya make it here. 

If you've ever wrestled with insecurity, comparison, perfectionism, shame, or simply wondered if you're doing this faith thing right, you're in good company. Around here, we believe God isn't looking for perfect people—He's transforming willing ones.

Each week, you'll find honest conversations, biblical encouragement, practical wisdom, a few laughs, and plenty of reminders that God's grace is bigger than your mistakes. We'll talk about identity in Christ, spiritual growth, confidence, purpose, relationships, and learning to trust a perfect God instead of trying to become a perfect person.

So grab your coffee, come as you are, and join us. Because we're all a little Holyish—and that's exactly where God's grace meets us.

New episodes every week.

title: Philippines Passport Renewal
author: Zulfkar Ali
description: Learn the DFA Passport Renewal process, and find why renewal matters. We will also disucss requirements, fee, procedure, and more.

title: Meet The Collective
author: G-Woman Radio
description:
The Meet the Collective is a weekly live radio show on G-Woman Radio that introduces listeners to the remarkable women who make up the G-Woman Collective. Each episode hosted by Alex Okoroji features two members in an engaging, light-hearted conversation where they share who they are, what they do, what inspires them, and the experiences that have shaped their journeys.

Rather than formal interviews, the show feels like sitting around the table with friends, full of laughter, surprises, meaningful conversations, and genuine human connection. By giving members a platform to be seen, heard, and celebrated, the program strengthens relationships across the Collective while inspiring global listeners through authentic stories from everyday women creating extraordinary impact.

title: DN4 - A Doncaster Rovers podcast
author: Liam Hoden and Robbie Andrews
description: Analysis, debate and discussion on all things Doncaster Rovers from two experts on the club, Robbie Andrews and Liam Hoden with some special guests along for the ride.

title: The United Foundry
author: Listening Dog Media
description:
An independent Manchester United fan channel hosted by Gaz Drinkwater, bringing United supporters the latest news, honest opinions and proper debate on everything happening at Old Trafford.

Expect regular Manchester United transfer updates, match previews, instant reactions, weekly podcasts, player analysis, interviews and discussion around the biggest stories affecting the club.

Gaz is joined by guests, contributors and supporters to break down performances, transfers and the decisions shaping Manchester United — without the noise, agendas or recycled talking points.

Whether you are watching from Manchester or supporting United from anywhere in the world, subscribe and become part of The United Foundry.

Manchester United. Forged through discussion.

title: The Premier Optical Eye Care Podcast
author: Premier Optical
description: Clear, practical conversations about eye health, vision tests, eyeglasses, contact lenses, lens technology, and everyday visual comfort. Each episode turns Premier Optical’s eye-care guides into useful information that helps individuals and families understand their vision, prepare for eye exams, and make informed eyewear choices.

title: Casita Cocco Radio
author: CasitaCoccoRadio
description:
Reporting & interviews for thoughtful travelers, immigrants and expats who want to engage with art in Barcelona
© 2026 Casita Cocco Radio. All rights reserved.

title: Tarot for Humans
author: Lindsay Nelson | Pink Moon Audio
description:
What if Tarot wasn't about predicting the future, but helping you make sense of the exact moment you're in?
Tarot for Humans is a series of mini-episodes that feel like voice notes from your witchy best bud or your sorta bossy big sis (because I'm all of those things 💖).
Using Tarot as a tool for reflection and POV-shifting, each episode explores a specific life moment: from overthinking a text to starting something new to feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or ready for a change.
No gatekeeping. No fortune-telling. Just perspective, a little magic, and tools for navigating real life.

title: Streetmotherz Podcast
author: Tiffany Davis
description:
Our Podcast will deliver a rollercoaster of raw emotions, stories and hardships of being a product of our environment.
We talk about the harsh realities of the streets. The struggles of being involved and/or raising children that are in the streets. Many don't understand what we've seen and even been through. We are here to share with the world our stories.
Warning: Our content may be offensive to some viewers.
We will allow our platform to be a safe space for guest to express themselves. We don't judge, we listen.

title: George T. The Movie Geek
author: George Tedino iii
description: I will talk about news,  actors, actresses, give my reviews, and preview  movies and occasionally  tv shows.

title: Still Going Strong (?)
author: I am Matthew Ministries
description: Our 20-year marriage has been anything but ordinary—filled with laughter, tears, victories, and struggles. We’ve known the weight of trying to make it on our own and the freedom of building a marriage centered on Christ. On the Still Going Strong (?) Podcast, we open the door to honest conversations about love, faith, forgiveness, and perseverance. We don’t pretend to have all the answers, but we do know this: Christ makes all the difference. Our hope is to encourage you, make you laugh, and remind you that with Him, your marriage can stand.

title: Car Parking Multiplayer Updates & News
author: Eleanor
description: Welcome to Car Parking Multiplayer Updates & News, a podcast for CPM players who want to stay informed about the latest game developments. In each episode, we discuss Car Parking Multiplayer updates, new cars, customization features, maps, multiplayer improvements, gameplay changes, bug fixes, and other interesting developments from the CPM community. Whether you are a regular player, a car customization fan, or simply interested in what is coming next to Car Parking Multiplayer, this podcast is designed to keep you updated. We also discuss important changes that players should know about and highlight interesting features that can improve the overall CPM gaming experience. Follow the podcast for regular discussions about Car Parking Multiplayer updates, new features, cars, all car parking multiplayer location maps, multiplayer gameplay, and gaming news.

title: Jake’s Reddit Stories
author: Jake’s Reddit Stories
description: Hey, I'm Jake. I read the craziest Reddit stories so you don't have to. Relationship drama, workplace disasters, family chaos – all the good stuff. Perfect for background listening while you do literally anything else. New stories all the time.

title: A- List Kitchen with Chef Keis Briscoe
author: chefkeisbriscoe
description: A List Kitchen is where great food, good conversation, and A-List energy come together. Hosted by Chef Keis Briscoe, the series goes beyond the headlines, helping viewers get to know the person behind the personality. While preparing and sharing a meal, guests open up about their journeys, passions, challenges, and the experiences that shaped who they are. Through authentic conversations and unforgettable moments, A List Kitchen creates a space where food becomes the connection and every story has a seat at the table.

title: Converse With Kaffy Podcast
author: Kafayat Gbajabiamila
description:
Converse with Kaffy is a podcast for anyone navigating the beautiful, messy, and meaningful journey of life.


Hosted by Kaffy, each episode invites you into honest conversations about the things we often think about but don't always talk about; purpose, relationships, growth, identity, resilience, work, family, faith, failure, hope, and everything in between.


This isn't a place where anyone pretends to have all the answers. It's a space to ask thoughtful questions, share real experiences, and learn together, one conversation at a time.


Whether you're celebrating a new beginning, facing an unexpected challenge, or simply looking for conversations that leave you feeling encouraged and understood, there's a seat for you here.


Pull up a chair. There's room for you here.

title: Let’s F’N Go Podcast
author: Samantha Gunn
description:
A radical self-honesty podcast designed to bring new perspectives on life’s challenges and traumas. 


“The truth never changes, but your relationship with it can!” - Samantha Gunn

title: Harvest IOC
author: Harvest Church Albany
description: Enjoy and catch up with our Sunday messages … remember to visit us in person when your in Albany Western Australia

title: Confrontation Station
author: Masseeh Radfar & Craig McLoughlin
description:
Confrontation Station breaks down real confrontations, high-pressure situations and moments where people are forced to make split-second decisions.
Using viral videos, public interactions and real-world incidents, we analyze body language, psychology, escalation, de-escalation, authority, confidence, persuasion and the choices people make when emotions take over. From arguments and street confrontations to police encounters, workplace disputes and everyday conflicts, every episode asks the same question: why did people react the way they did?
Hosted by Massey and Craig, Confrontation Station is about understanding human behaviour when the pressure is on.

title: PiazzAsiago
author: PiazzAsiago
description: PiazzAsiago è la rassegna culturale e politica ideata e condotta da David Parenzo e Alessandro De Angelis, in programma dal 1 al 5 agosto ad Asiago.

title: The PortCast Official
author: D111 FILMS U.S.A.
description: THE PORTCAST is the media voice of Port Laredo — North America's Leading Trade Gateway. Broadcast-grade conversations with the carriers, brokers, port officials, and decision-makers moving North American trade. Hosted by Felipe Romero & David Romero.

title: Food Noise Is Not the Villain You Think It Is
author: Daryl Perry
description:
Food noise has become a huge part of the conversation around eating, weight loss, and GLP-1 medications. But what does food noise actually mean to you?
Hosted by Daryl Perry of Your Level Fitness, this podcast takes a more nuanced look at the thoughts, feelings, habits, and experiences we often group together as food noise. No fear, guilt, shame, or one-size-fits-all answers. Just honest conversations to help you better understand your relationship with food and find what works for you for life.

title: The Unintended School
author: Dr. Cathy White
description: The Unintended School explores what happens when reasonable choices, good intentions, and everyday habits create consequences we never meant to build into the school system.

title: AMBS UNFILTERED with Amber Greaves
author: amber greaves
description: Ambs Unfiltered is your new weekly dose of real talk with your internet bestie, host Amber Greaves. Join this 29-year-old entrepreneur, creator, and pop culture fanatic as she serves up unfiltered advice on life, business, relationships, and chasing your biggest goals. Need a happy escape? Want to feel motivated to take control of your life? Press play and settle in—it’s time for some encouraging, feel-good vibes designed to remind you that it's never too late to go after your dreams.

title: Dear Self : Navigating Through 20s
author: Jerlyn Sagayaraj
description: Time to do a reality check🥂 - your twenties are a chaotic cocktail of trying to build a career, surviving timeline anxiety, and wondering if eating sugary cereal for dinner counts as self-care (spoiler: it does). We are breaking down the comparison olympics, social media curation fatigue, and corporate guilt with zero filter. We aren’t experts; we’re just figuring out how to protect our peace and choose our own happiness. Consider this a love letter, a guide, and a warm hug to your evolving self. Hit subscribe, grab your matcha or whatever drink, and let’s navigate the plot twists together.✨

title: Echo 24: Conversations
author: KaayRizzy
description: Echo 24 is a media space built around real conversations, personal growth, and storytelling. The platform explores identity, mindset, discipline, relationships, and the ongoing process of becoming who you’re meant to be. Through interviews and honest dialogue, Echo 24 highlights different perspectives on life, growth, and self-discovery. Every episode is rooted in truth, reflection, and evolution—no filters, no perfection, just real conversation.

title: The Tarah and Barry Show
author: Tarah and Barry
description:
Welcome to "The Tarah and Barry Show," your weekly deep dive into the world of ADHD in life and love!


Every Monday AND Thursday, join us for a blend of playful banter, insightful stories, and actionable advice, as we unpack what it's like living with ADHD and navigating it in romantic relationships. 


We're not here to tell you that ADHD is your superpower. But we are here to help you understand yourself, feel seen, and offer real, transformative strategies to work with your ADHD, rather than against it.


Whether you're self-diagnosed, have a formal diagnosis, or are simply curious about ADHD, our show has something special for you.


Are you ready to join the family? Hit that subscribe button, become a part of our FREE Facebook community, or elevate your experience by joining our exclusive "Neurospicy Family Membership." Let's embrace ADHD together and thrive in love and life.

title: English speakers
author: Nouredine Nachite
description: Tune in to Episode 3 for all things English! From essential vocabulary to conversational phrases, this episode is a must-listen for beginners diving into the language. Packed with tips, tricks, and engaging exercises, you'll boost your language skills in no time. Don't miss out on leveling up your English game with Episode 3 - your ticket to fluency starts here!

title: Redemption Stories
author: Carrie Newman
description: In this episode of Redemption Stories, host Carrie Newman shares her personal testimony of redemption, healing, and restoration through Jesus Christ. Drawing from the biblical accounts of the Prodigal Son and the Woman at the Well, Carrie reflects on her own struggles with past trauma, fear, and broken relationships, and how God's grace transformed her life and marriage. This devotional podcast encourages listeners to trust God's plan, embrace His forgiveness, and discover how their own stories can bring them closer to Him

title: Pull The Permit
author: Chris Fink
description:
Pull the Permit is the show for home service contractors who are done guessing and ready to build something that lasts.
Hosts Chris Fink and Keith Eneix cut through the noise on what it actually takes to run and scale a contracting business: hiring, marketing, leads, money, systems, and the hard calls owners face every day. No fluff, no theory, no recycled advice. Just straight talk from operators who have been in it, plus the occasional guest contractor or industry pro who has built something worth learning from.
Whether you run HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, remodeling, or restoration,

title: BuildCast Podcast
author: Frontier Building Group
description:
Two brothers. One mic. Zero filter.

Jonathan and Chris have been in the construction and real estate world long enough to know one thing: everybody lies to you about renovation. The price, the timeline, the "simple" project that turns into a nightmare. Nobody tells you the truth until it's too late.

That ends here.

BuildCast is where real construction conversations happen. No polished corporate answers. No fear of controversy. Just two guys who've seen it all, done it all, and aren't afraid to disagree with each other on the way to getting you the truth.

Every episode covers what homeowners actually need to know before they spend a dollar, sign a contract, or trust a contractor with the biggest investment of their life.

If you want glossy renovation TV, this isn't it.

If you want the real conversation, hit follow.

New episodes every week from Frontier Building Group, serving Brantford, Brant County, Norfolk County, Haldimand County, and surrounding communities in Ontario.

title: Faith and Favor
author: Joanne Gabriel
description:
Faith & Favor is a Christian podcast hosted by Joanne Gabriel, where faith meets healing through honest conversations about shields, stories, and salvation. 
Every episode unpacks a protective shield we often build because of sin, pain, or trauma—such as hyper-independence, self-preservation, or fear. Joanne then shares the personal story behind each shield and reveals how Jesus lovingly dismantles those defenses to bring true freedom and restoration. 
Join Joanne and guests to discover that our greatest protection isn't the walls we build, but the Savior who makes us whole.

title: Bright Side Universe +
author: TheSoul Publishing
description: Whether you’re into recent discoveries, space exploration, true stories, fitness, fun tests, and riddles, or useful tips for self-improvement, psychology, gadgets, or just your day-to-day routine, there’s something for everyone at Bright Side Universe+!

author: Nathaniel Harvey
description:

title: Build to Last
author: Build to Last
description: Built to Last is the podcast for people who want to build big things from the ground up. A mix of self-development and infrastructure finance, no unnecessary jargon, just concrete ideas to help you grow, in your career and in your life.

title: Life-changing decisions for 40s
author: Lukas Weber
description:
Good Life Podcast: Building Better Money Habits, One Decision at a Time
Welcome to the Good Life Podcast — a place where money, mindset, habits, and personal growth come together.
This podcast is created for anyone who wants to understand money beyond numbers.
Because financial success is not only about how much you earn.
It is about how you think.
How you spend.
How you prepare.
And how you build habits that create the future you want.
In Season 1, "The Truth About Emergency Funds," we explored one of the most important foundations of financial confidence: preparation.
We uncovered why emergency funds are not just savings accounts, but a source of freedom, security, and peace of mind.
We discussed how to prepare for unexpected moments, how small saving habits create powerful results, and why protecting your future self is one of the smartest financial decisions you can make.
In Season 2, "How to Stop Living Paycheque to Paycheque," we went deeper into the psychology behind money struggles.
We explored why hardworking people can still feel financially trapped, why budgets fail, how emotions influence spending, and how creating better financial systems can change your life.
Through conversations inspired by timeless ideas from books such as:
- The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel
- Atomic Habits by James Clear
- The Richest Man in Babylon by George S. Clason
- Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman
we explore practical lessons that help listeners develop stronger financial awareness.
Every episode is designed to make you think deeper, ask better questions, and take meaningful action.
This podcast is not about becoming rich overnight.
It is about becoming wiser every day.
Because a better financial future is not created by one perfect decision.
It is created by thousands of better decisions repeated consistently.
Join us as we explore:
- Money psychology
- Saving strategies
- Financial habits
- Wealth-building principles
- Personal growth
- Life-changing decisions
Ask yourself:
What financial habit is shaping my future today?
What decision would my future self thank me for?
What could change if I became more intentional with my money?
Welcome to the Good Life Podcast.
Where better choices create better lives.

title: The Aging Well Blueprint
author: Rodger
description: The Aging Well Blueprint is a practical health and wellness podcast designed to help you understand how everyday choices affect the way you age. Each episode explores nutrition, hydration, strength, mobility, heart and brain health, sleep, stress, preventive health, and the simple daily habits that can help you stay active, independent, and engaged for years to come.

title: The Unfiltered Frequency
author: Bonnie Comfort
description:
The Unfiltered Frequency is where nothing is off-limits. From paranormal encounters and unexplained phenomena to music trends, entertainment, interviews, and culture, we dive into the conversations others won’t. Raw opinions, real stories, unexpected perspectives, and completely unfiltered conversations—tuning into the frequency beyond the ordinary.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/the-unfiltered-frequency--7248252/support.

title: The Smoking Boof Podcast
author: Jaypeg
description: Sheeeeeesh

title: Eastern Edge
author: Kaleb Cavalier
description:
Eastern Edge is the podcast dedicated to the NHL Eastern Conference, Eastern PWHL teams, and hockey history.
Hosted by Kaleb Cavalier, each episode breaks down the latest from all 16 Eastern NHL teams, covers the top Eastern PWHL squads, and features engaging history segments. The show also analyzes major Western Conference moves through an Eastern Conference lens.
New episodes every Friday at noon ET

title: The Eternal Thread
author: Rajesh Chowdhry, Your Fellow Traveler
description:
The Eternal Thread is a quiet space for exploring how consciousness, attention, and realization shape the reality we live in.
Drawing from quantum field perspectives and classical Indian thought, these conversations look at how we participate in the world — not as distant observers, but as part of the field itself.
Topics include mind and language, the accumulation of realization, the illusion of separation, and the path toward Mukti. This is not a podcast of final answers. It is an invitation to look more carefully at how we see, speak, and take part in reality.

title: Deep and Ridiculous with Anthony Marino
author: Anthony Marino
description:
Where Wisdom meets Humour.
Conversations about life that make you think Deeply and laugh Ridiculously.

title: Audio Fiction FM
author: Marisa Ewing
description:
Created by Hemlock Creek Productions, Audio Fiction FM is a show for those looking to discover new audio fiction, whether you've been enjoying audio only shows for years or are looking to start listening for the first time. Host Marisa Ewing-Moody, audio drama editor and creator of "Liars & Leeches," will share news from the audio fiction world, the first episode of a piece of audio fiction, and an interview with that show's creators.


Join us for the premiere of Audio Fiction FM on our YouTube, August 12th at 8:00pm central time, where you can chat in real time with fans and audio drama creators as you listen. If you miss the premiere, or would prefer to listen to an audio only version, all episodes will be uploaded wherever you get your podcasts.


New episodes will be released on the second Wednesday of every month.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Podcasting and AI
author: John Jamingo
description: Podcasting and A.I. follows John Jamingo as he learns artificial intelligence in real time, on camera, mistakes and all. No scripts, no fake expertise, just a working podcaster figuring out how AI can actually help with research, production, and post-production, one fumble at a time. If you make podcasts and you're curious about AI but a little intimidated by it, this is the show that proves you can learn as you go, right alongside him and his AI co-host Claudette.

title: Stories We Inherit: History Through Their Eyes
author: Sophie and Isabel
description: Stories We Inherit explores the stories, memories, and histories beyond the textbooks we read in class. Through the personal perspectives of the older generation, we uncover the untold stories behind historical events across the world, giving voice to the experiences, memories, and lessons that are often left out of the history books. These are the stories passed down through generations that continue to shape who we are today.

title: The Conscious Leaders UNFILTERED
author: Cheryl x Kiah
description:
What if leadership isn't about the people you manage—but about how you show up every single day?
The Conscious Leaders Unfiltered is where authentic conversations meet conscious living. Join Cheryl and co-host Kiah as they explore the real, unfiltered side of leadership—self-leadership, relationships, emotional intelligence, purpose, courage, and growth. Because conscious leadership isn't a title. It's a way of living, loving, and leading that creates lasting impact—whether you're leading one person or many.

There will doubtless be a diversity of opinion as to their value. One critic, for instance, has called “The Story of a Famous Old Jewish Firm” a witless squib; but, on the other hand, the late Professor Clifford considered it a piece of exquisite mordant satire worthy of Swift. Such differences are inevitable from the very nature of the subject. Satire, more than any other form of composition, rouses antipathy where it does not command applause; and the greater the satire, the more intense are the feelings it excites." (G. W. Foote in his Preface)

description:
Everybody takes punches. The comeback is the story.

Can’t Catch a Break is a long-form interview podcast about resilience, perseverance, and the human ability to come back from the moments that were supposed to break us.


Hosted by Reece Arthur, each episode sits down with someone who has been through a season when life simply would not let up. The circumstances are different—loss, addiction, illness, failure, heartbreak, career setbacks, unexpected change, or moments when everything seemed to fall apart—but the conversation doesn’t end with what went wrong.


Because Can’t Catch a Break isn’t a pity party.


We talk about the first punch. The hardest punch. Who was in their corner. What it really took to get back up. And how they’re punching back.


These are honest conversations about the parts of resilience that don't always look inspirational while you're living them—the people who show up, the days you barely make it through, the decisions that change your direction, and the moment surviving begins turning into rebuilding.

Some guests you'll know. Others you won't. Their stories may be completely different from yours.

But everyone knows what it feels like to get hit by life.


The punch gets us into the story. The comeback is why we stay.


Welcome to Can’t Catch a Break.

Taking Life’s Punches. And Punching Right Back.

title: Elements of Geology
author: William Harmon Norton
description: Geology is a science of such rapid growth that no apology is expected when from time to time a new text-book is added to those already in the field. The present work, however, is the outcome of the need of a text-book of very simple outline, in which causes and their consequences should be knit together as closely as possible,—a need long felt by the author in his teaching, and perhaps by other teachers also. The author has ventured, therefore, to depart from the common usage which subdivides geology into a number of departments,—dynamical, structural, physiographic, and historical,—and to treat in immediate connection with each geological process the land forms and the rock structures which it has produced. (from book preface)

From the most devastating parts of life, to the most joyful parts of life. How Autumn Feels is not just letting go of the old, to let the new in. It’s part of the process to understand the most difficult parts of life and why certain things happen. I have looked a life very differently, the last several years. Almost dying several times, to dealing with grief and walking alone. I never had no one there for me, but I was always there for myself. I was never about the sympathy, but I always had the courage to share my story. I was always blunt and never held back how I actually felt, which many tried to change that. I never let anyone change me, I always remained who I truly was, and I was thankful for that.

title: CANDID ON CALLING | Purpose, Clarity, Confidence, Discernment, God’s Plan, Midlife, Christian Women, Identity in Christ
author: Arris Charles | Life Purpose Coach for Christian Women
description:
Have you spent years wondering how to find your life purpose, but still feel uncertain about God’s calling on your life?
Do you find yourself holding back from the purpose God has placed on your heart because of doubt or fear?
Are you tired of second-guessing yourself or wondering whether you’re truly following God’s plan?
Are you ready to stop feeling stuck and unfulfilled and start living with clarity, confidence, and peace about who God created you to be and what He’s calling you to do?
I’m so glad you’re here!
In this Christian women’s podcast on life purpose, we get candid on calling, going beneath the surface to explore God’s truth, the path to clarity and confidence, and the real-life questions, challenges, and growth that come with pursuing your purpose as a Christian woman, especially in midlife and times of transition.
Through biblical wisdom, practical insights, and honest conversations, you’ll find guidance and encouragement for embracing your God-given identity, discerning your unique calling, aligning with God’s leading, and living purposefully in every season.
If you’re ready to stop wondering, wandering, and waiting and start becoming and fulfilling all God has purposed for you, Candid on Calling is the right place for you.
Hi, I’m Arris. Years ago, I was in a role that seemed to give me a good life on the outside, but it wasn’t giving me life on the inside. Deep down, I felt a longing that wouldn’t go away to find the true purpose God had for me and understand how He wanted to use my life. As I became more intentional about drawing closer to God and seeking His direction, I eventually walked away from where I was so I could make space to discover where He was leading me. In the process, I found much greater clarity about what I was called to do.
But even after finding that clarity, I discovered that knowing what I was called to do wasn’t enough. Self-doubt, fear, limiting beliefs, and the challenges of everyday life were still holding me back from fully stepping into it.
What I learned is that walking in your calling isn’t just about knowing what you’re called to do. It’s about learning to see yourself the way God sees you, recognizing what God has placed within you and the patterns He has been revealing throughout your life. And as you trust His leading, you can take steps of faith and courage, even in difficult seasons.
That’s why I’m passionate about helping Christian women grow in the clarity, confidence, courage, and faith to live out God’s purpose for their lives.
Are you longing to make the difference God created you to make? Whether you don’t yet know your specific purpose, have a general sense of it but need more direction, or find yourself struggling to move forward in what you’re called to do, I’d love to walk alongside you.
If you’re a Christian woman who wants to live with more clarity, confidence, passion, and impact–especially in midlife and beyond–come join the conversation.
Let’s get candid on calling.

author: Marco R. Torres
description:
The Talking TACMED Audio Series

One skill. Twenty minutes. No guests, no fluff.

TACMED TWENTY is the audio side of Talking TACMED, hosted by Dr. Marco R. Torres — physician, flight and critical care paramedic, Navy veteran, and founder of MED-TAC International.

Each episode takes a single tactical medicine skill and works it to the ground: what kills, what the doctrine actually says, how it fails in the field, and a drill you can run today with no equipment.

What makes this show different is what happens at the end of every episode. Doc states the evidence tier out loud and names at least one specific gap in it. Manufacturer claims get labeled as manufacturer claims. When the show gets something wrong, the correction is made on-mic, in the episode.

Four times a season, that habit becomes its own format: the Claim Audit, where a claim everyone repeats gets traced back to what it actually rests on.

For law enforcement, fire, EMS, military, and anyone who has decided they are not going to stand there and watch.

Free field guides and reference cards at tactical-medicine.com — no cost, no course to buy first.

Clinician founded. Veteran led. Service-disabled veteran-owned. South Florida, US of A.

author: FirstWord Podcast Network

description:

Hosted by grief specialist Sharon Brubaker, it's an unfiltered look at what grief actually does to you and how to face it head-on. Sharon brings her own story, real conversations, and practical tools that cut through the noise.
If you're done with people minimizing your pain and you want the truth about grief, this is it. Grieve That Shit is where the rawness lives—and where real healing begins.

title: Scams, Fraud & Business Deception
author: Joshua Peterr
description: Behind every great scam is a story.A convincing lie. An ambitious plan. Money changing hands. People willing to believe. And eventually, something that brings the whole thing crashing down.Scams, Fraud & Business Deception is a narrative podcast exploring the true stories behind extraordinary scams, financial frauds, corporate scandals, Ponzi schemes, fake entrepreneurs, deceptive business empires, and some of the most audacious cons in history.Each episode takes you inside a different case — from billion-dollar companies built on questionable claims to charismatic fraudsters who convinced investors, customers, and sometimes entire industries to trust them.But this podcast isn't only about what happened.It's about how the deception worked.How did they gain people's trust?Where did the money go?Why didn't anyone notice?Why did intelligent people believe them?And what finally caused everything to unravel?Follow the money. Examine the lies. Discover the psychology behind the deception.These are true stories of money, lies and greed.New episodes explore cases from business, finance, technology, cryptocurrency, startups, investing, internet culture, and history.

title: Agape Love
author: Maya
description:
Agape Love is a podcast about the extraordinary, unconditional love parents have for their children with disabilities and neurodivergence—and the strength, grief, joy, resilience, and community that grow from that love.  Agape Love isn't a podcast about autism. It's a podcast about the parents who love children with disabilities with a kind of love that has no conditions and no expiration date. 


Who needs to hear this?

 

This podcast is for the mother who just heard the words, “Your child has autism,” and has no idea what tomorrow looks like.

 

It’s for the mother whose child wandered away from home and was found in a dangerous situation—and who still replays those terrifying moments in her mind.

 

It’s for the mother who feels like no one in her family truly understands what life is like inside her home.

 

It’s for the mother carrying guilt because one child needs so much of her that her other children receive what’s left.

 

It’s for the mother who wishes co-parenting looked different—who longs for someone else to understand, advocate, and share the weight of this journey.

 

It’s for the mother who hasn’t slept through the night in years because her child doesn’t sleep.

 

It’s for the mother who constantly thinks three steps ahead because safety is never something she can take for granted.

 

It’s for the mother who dreams about self-care but can’t imagine finding the time, the support, or the resources to make it possible.

 

It’s for the mother whose heart overflows with joy when her child sings in a choir concert, says a new word, makes a friend, or simply experiences a moment of belonging.

 

It’s for the mother who wants nothing more than for her child to experience kindness, acceptance, dignity, and the goodness this world has to offer.

 

Most of all, it’s for the parent who has ever whispered to themselves, “I feel so alone.”

 

I want them to know they aren’t.

 

Because somewhere, another parent is carrying the very same hope, fear, exhaustion, and unconditional love.

 

Agape Love is where those parents find each other.

 

It’s where we remind one another that while this journey can feel incredibly lonely, we never have to walk it alone.

title: Addressing Outdated Policies In  America
author: Dr. Sam Weah Monboe
description:
Addressing Outdated Policies in America is a long‑form documentary podcast that examines the laws, systems, and public policies that no longer serve the people they were designed to protect. Through cinematic narration, historical context, and investigative storytelling, each episode explores a single outdated American policy — from child support enforcement and immigration reform to healthcare failures, criminal justice practices, and other social systems in need of modernization.

This podcast is created for listeners who want to understand why certain policies remain unchanged, how they impact everyday Americans, and what history reveals about the path forward. Every episode is crafted as a standalone documentary, offering deep research, compelling narration, and clear explanations of complex issues.

If you’re interested in American policy reform, social justice, government systems, or documentary‑style storytelling, this series delivers a powerful, accessible look at the policies shaping our lives — and the urgent need to update them.

description:
Apartheid. White supremacy. Zionism. Palestinian identity. The future of Judaism. Israel’s relationship with its Arab neighbours. These are conversational landmines, the kind that end dinner parties and friendships, and that most people dare not touch.

This show walks straight through the minefield.

Yirmiyahu Danzig (@that_semite) is known for confronting the conversations most people avoid, bringing strong convictions but also a rare willingness to engage people who see the world differently. Caribbean, Ashkenazi, and Palestinian-Jewish by descent, he has built an online following of millions by refusing the usual scripts and narratives, crossing traditionally hard-set ideological borders by speaking to everyone in the language of genuine, openhearted curiosity.

On Borderlines, he brings that approach to the most contested subjects in Israel and Jewish life, taking the big questions seriously enough to resist easy answers. Haredim and secular Israelis. Zionism and its critics. Palestinians, Arab citizens of Israel and the wider Arab world. What Judaism is becoming, and who gets to decide. These are conversations with experts and insiders who understand the issues but are willing to be challenged, and where the familiar arguments and talking points simply won’t cut it.

Come for the questions you've been afraid to ask. Stay because someone's finally looking for honest answers.

Brought to you by Unpacked. New episodes weekly.

title: Grounded: Understanding the Core Truths of Christianity

description: This podcast is a Bible-centered study designed to help believers build a strong foundation for their faith. In this series, Pastor Jeremy Gates, lead pastor of Cave Spring Church in Owens Cross Roads Alabama, will dive into the essential doctrines of Christianity. Topics will include God, Scripture, salvation, Jesus Christ, the Holy Spirit, the Church, and eternity. Our prayer is that through this podcast you can grow and discover how these timeless truths shape the way you think, live, and follow Christ. Whether you're new to the faith or looking to deepen your understanding, this study will equip you to know what you believe, why you believe it, and how to confidently live it out.

This podcast is about creating a Qur'anic lifestyle, nurturing faith, building beautiful character, and supporting emotional, social and spiritual wellbeing through the timeless guidance of the Qur'an and Sunnah.
Whether you're a parent raising children upon faith, a teenager discovering your identity, a young adult navigating life's challenges, an educator, a counsellor, or simply someone seeking to strengthen your relationship with Allah, this is a space for you.
Each episode offers Qur'anic insights, Prophetic wisdom, Reflection on Positive Affirmations and Du'a.

Ophthalmology epiphanies through patient stories...hear real patients' journey through eye disease heroically... listen to them weave a  memorable tapestry, hosted by retina specialist and global health specialist, Robin D. With a mix of honest storytelling, thoughtful discussion, and unfiltered perspectives, Sean brings guests and conversations together that challenge ideas, inspire growth, and remind us that confidence and humility can coexist.

Whether you're here to learn something new, hear a different perspective, or simply enjoy a great conversation, you're in the right place.

New episodes weekly.

Cocky enough to speak your mind. Humble enough to keep learning.

description:
Of all the books on all the shelves in all the world. You found me. And I found you.
📚
Have you ever finished a book and wondered how it found its way into your life at exactly the moment you needed it? Welcome to The Books That Found Me, a solo narrative podcast hosted by Jasdev. 
This isn't just a podcast that reviews books; it explores what stories reveal about being human. Through classics, contemporary novels, memoirs and new releases, we discover why certain books stay with us. 
📖
Because sometimes we do not simply find a book. Sometimes a book finds us.

A family, a freindship, and now a brand.

We have 3 adult children and have been through all the ups and downs. We're in our 40s but have at least 400 years of stories as we navigated parenthood, youth, and life as kids ourselves.
It is our joy now to share our stories with you all and offer any help we can while laughing along the way.

title: What's the GOAT?

Each episode, friends Matt and Mat bring three contenders apiece, argue their cases and attempt to destroy each other’s choices with facts, passion and highly questionable logic.
But they do not choose the winner. You do.
After every episode, listeners vote on social media to decide which contender deserves to be crowned the GOAT.
Six contenders. Two opinionated hosts. One impossible question.
What’s the GOAT?

title: Hey Monica

description: Welcome to Hey Monica, the podcast for the recovering perfectionist, the chronic organizer, and anyone tired of diet culture. The name is a loving nod to TV’s competitive, bossy neat-freak, Monica Geller. This show is a weekly conversation with the older, wiser "Monica" inside all of us—the one who still feels the pull to be perfect, but is choosing to live a life rooted in peace, values, and grace instead.  Join hosts Tia (professional home organizer and founder of Room for Serenity) and Amber (weight-inclusive licensed nutritionist and founder of Whole You Nutrition). Together, they offer practical, judgment-free wisdom to help you declutter your space, ditch food rules, and make room for what actually matters—in your home, in your food, and in your life.

title: Ham In The Sandwich (H.I.T.S)
author: Stella Uwaechue
description:
The Diary of a Mid-Level Management Career Professional: Life as the Ham in the Sandwich

There is a stage in your career no one really prepares you for.

You’re no longer junior enough to be guided, but not yet senior enough to control the game.

You’re expected to deliver results, manage people, interpret strategy, navigate stakeholders, protect your team, grow yourself — and somehow maintain a life outside work.

Welcome to the middle. Welcome to H.I.T.S. — Ham in the Sandwich.

This is the space between leadership and responsibility, ambition and reality, career and life.

Here, we talk about what it really means to navigate the middle:

Managing Up. Managing Sideways. Managing Down.

We explore career transitions, workplace dynamics, leadership, generational differences, continuous learning, financial growth, relationships, relocation, identity, the future of work, AI, and the difficult questions that emerge when you're no longer simply building a career — you're building a life.

Hosted by Stella Uwaechue, The Diary of a Mid-Level Management Career Professional is a weekly collection of honest reflections, hard-earned lessons, observations and conversations about navigating the middle.

Because sometimes the hardest place to be isn't at the bottom or the top.

It's in between.

If you're somewhere in that middle — trying to build, grow, lead, adapt and make sense of it all — this diary is for you.

Welcome to the sandwich stage.

description:
The Melanated Mindset™ is an intimate space for honest conversations about what it really means to grow, heal, evolve, and create a life that feels aligned with your purpose. Not just one that looks good from the outside.

Hosted by Tahj, a creative, storyteller, mother, and wellness entrepreneur, The Melanated Mindset™ explores the intersection of community, self-care, empowerment, healing, holistic wellness, and purpose through a distinctly Black and culturally conscious lens.

But this isn't a podcast about simply knowing better.
It's about living better.

Because awareness is recognizing the pattern.
Healing is doing the work.

Through personal stories, honest reflections, practical tools, and conversations with inspiring voices, Tahj explores what happens when the lessons we've learned actually have to be lived—in our homes, relationships, careers, finances, bodies, businesses, and everyday choices.

title: Real stories as a Bomb and Mine disposal Diver in the Royal Navy

description:
Hello and welcome.
My name is Stephen, and over the years I’ve worked as a Royal Navy Clearance Diver, Salvage Diver and Offshore Commercial Diver.
In these podcast, I’ll be sharing true stories from a life spent above and below the waterline. From the events and experiences of my youth that helped shape the direction of my life, through military service and basic training, to qualifying as a Royal Navy Clearance Diver.
I’ll talk about military diving operations around the UK and Northern Ireland during the Troubles, including underwater bomb disposal, explosive ordnance work, night attacks

title: Geoffrey Boycott: An Extraordinary Innings
author: The Telegraph
description:
Sir Geoffrey Boycott is one of England's greatest ever cricketers. From extremely humble beginnings in the terraced streets of the Yorkshire mining village of Fitzwilliam, he went on to play 108 Test matches for England, becoming the leading Test run scorer in the world and one of the game’s all-time greats.


Now 85, and following a second brilliant career as a broadcaster - most notably on the BBC's Test Match Special and in India for Ten Sports - Sir Geoffrey is seriously ill. Diagnosed with throat cancer for the second time in July 2024, he is facing perhaps his greatest battle yet. 


The Telegraph's chief cricket correspondent, Nick Hoult, has had the privilege of getting to know Sir Geoffrey very well over the last two decades in his role as one of our esteemed cricket columnists, and he was recently invited to spend twenty four hours with him at his home in Cheshire. 


One of the game's most colourful, and at times controversial, characters; this new four-part special podcast series is Sir Geoffrey Boycott’s life in his own words.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Peace Over Panic: Life Beyond Anxiety
author: Taylor Barone MS, RDN
description:
Welcome to Peace Over Panic.

I'm Taylor, a registered dietitian, anxiety advocate, and someone who has personally walked through panic attacks, health anxiety, OCD, and the exhausting cycle of fear. For years, anxiety convinced me my life would always be controlled by "what ifs." But through faith, evidence-based tools, and a whole lot of healing, I discovered something life-changing:

Peace is possible.

Each week, you'll find honest conversations about anxiety, panic disorder, OCD, health anxiety, nervous system regulation, mental health, and faith. Together we'll explore practical tools backed by research, biblical encouragement, and real-life strategies that help you stop merely surviving and start truly living again.

If you're constantly checking your body, caught in reassurance-seeking, overwhelmed by intrusive thoughts, or wondering if you'll ever feel like yourself again, you're not alone and you don't have to walk this journey by yourself.

This isn't a podcast that promises perfection.

It's a place where healing is possible, hope is restored, and every episode points you toward peace instead of panic.

Take a deep breath.

You're safe here.

Through personal stories, lived experience, community insights, and emerging research, Sam explores the cognitive changes, sensory overwhelm, burnout, physical symptoms, healthcare barriers, functioning regressions, and shifting support needs that can accompany neurodivergent menopause. Each episode offers an honest account of what happens when the strategies that worked for decades suddenly stop working, and the search for the knowledge, support, and language needed to navigate what comes next.


Whether you're autistic, ADHD, AuDHD, questioning the changes happening to your brain and body, or supporting someone who is, Autistic Menopause offers validation, practical insights, and the reassurance that you are not alone.


Sam also writes Divergent Menopause, a reader-supported Substack dedicated to neurodivergent experiences of perimenopause, menopause, and ageing. Every article is free to read, with paid subscriptions helping to fund advocacy, research translation, and community work.

This podcast series explains the complete structure of the FIDE exam and helps you understand how each section works, how skills are evaluated, and how marks are calculated.

Through this series, we break down every important part of the FIDE test — from the overall exam structure to detailed explanations of the spoken, listening, and written sections.

In this series, you will learn:

• Overview of FIDE – Understand what the FIDE test is, exam purpose, language levels (A1, A2, B1), exam format, requirements, and the role of FIDE in B permit, C permit, and Swiss naturalisation applications.

• Spoken Exam – Learn the structure of the oral exam, speaking tasks, assessment criteria, and how speaking performance is evaluated and scored.

• Listening Exam – Understand the listening section structure, types of listening tasks, evaluation methods, and how listening marks are calculated.

• Written Exam – Explore the written exam structure, reading and writing tasks, scoring system, and how written skills are assessed.

• FIDE FAQ – Get answers to common questions about exam preparation, registration, scoring, Language Passport, exam process, and test-day expectations.

Whether you are beginning your FIDE preparation or looking for a clear understanding of the exam system, FIDE Prep provides simple explanations and practical guidance to help you prepare effectively.

For FIDE practice tasks, sample exercises, mock tests, and complete preparation resources, visit:

https://fideprep.ch

Start your FIDE preparation journey today with FIDE Prep.

description: The University of Southern California's Center for Advancing Family Caregiver Financial and Workplace Security has launched a new podcast series, The Care Economy: Practical Approaches to Family Caregiving and Financial Well-Being, exploring one of today's most pressing and often overlooked economic issues: unpaid family caregiving. More than one in five U.S. adults provides care for a family member, creating financial strain, workplace disruption, and long-term economic consequences for families and employers alike. Funded by an Administration for Community Living grant, the podcast features solutions-oriented conversations with leaders in policy, finance, workplace benefits, law, and aging services, examining how systems can better protect caregivers' financial stability while strengthening workforce participation and community resilience. Produced and hosted by Maureen Feldman — a former family caregiver and longtime leader in aging and social connection initiatives — the series bridges expert analysis with lived experience to deliver practical, actionable insights for family caregivers and the professionals who support them, including Area Agencies on Aging, healthcare providers, employers, and policymakers. The Care Economy is available on major podcast platforms.
